title: Turkish-Style Charred Bean Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Turkish-inspired pilaf dish featuring charred beans and a hint of luxury.
instructions: Heat the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted (about 5 minutes).
Add the charred beans and stir to combine with the pilaf.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork to separate the grains.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
